title: Kenyan Chicken Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy Kenyan-inspired dish made with chicken and vegetables, cooked in a skillet to perfection.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Add the kenyan spice blend to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
